name: Survive: Escape from Atlantis!

categories.label: Explorer values on safe isles
categories.labelVi: Giá trị Explorer đã tới đảo an toàn
categories.hint: Flip your saved Explorer tokens and enter each printed value (1-6).

notes: family: set-collection-hidden-value. Game ends when the volcano tile is revealed (destroys remaining island and Explorers). Each player has 10 Explorers. Highest total wins, not most Explorers. With 2 players using two colours each, add both colours' values. Rulebook states no tiebreaker. Challenge #3 (All equal) ignores values and counts tokens: not modelled. Dolphins/Squids expansion not modelled.
